text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit southbound and northbound U-turn movements at all times on Lillian Street, between Otonabee Avenue and Abitibi Avenue.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited southbound and northbound U-turn movements at all times on Lillian Street, between Otonabee Avenue and Abitibi Avenue.
